title: Sites whose terms forbid automated reading: drop, link only, or ask permission?
summary: Three sites' terms restrict automated reading or use by AI (tempo.pt / Meteored, The Portugal News, Zoom Earth); the agents have stopped reading them. Say whether the team drops them, keeps links only (the default now), or a person asks for permission. Six more outlets have no terms page the reader could find and are still read from their public feeds: say if you want them paused.
closes: Your choice, recorded in research/media/licences.json and the weather watch's studies.
blocks: Those sites stay out of the media watch and the weather-sites studies beyond a link.
